# Pearl Bipin Photos

> Pearl Bipin Photos is the personal visual archive of Pearl Bipin, containing personal photographs, artwork, motorcycles, family memories, photographs of his pet cat Kitchu, food he cooks, and a small miscellaneous collection.

## Canonical site

- https://pearlbipinphotos.vercel.app/

## About

Pearl Bipin Photos is a single-page personal visual archive. The homepage is the canonical page for the site.

The site is organized into these sections:

- Personal — portraits, ordinary days, dressed-up days, and photographs Pearl Bipin chose to keep.
- Things I made — origami, drawings, sketches, and other handmade work.
- The motorcycle corner — photographs of Pearl Bipin, his motorcycles, and moments around two wheels.
- Memories — older photographs of Pearl Bipin, his parents, and family memories.
- The little details — photographs of Kitchu, food Pearl Bipin cooks, and miscellaneous music-related photographs.

The site uses the canonical homepage URL above. Section navigation uses in-page fragment URLs on that homepage rather than separate HTML pages.
